name: definition-history-year-table-calendar-months
description: Invalid definition (fiscalclock 0.3.0). Spec rule, paraphrased: An entry's year is validated as the top-level year: year type table is no longer reserved, and a table year with a calendar_months subdivision is UNSUPPORTED_COMBINATION at the prefixed path. This vector replaces a 0.2.0 vector whose expected error changed in 0.3.0, as issue #85 explains, definition-history-year-reserved, which expected UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE for year type table. The definition has no other error, so the complete error list is asserted (code and path of each error, sorted by path, then code).
